Name: Busty Alex
Author: SillyBobThorton
Description:
-WHAT THIS MOD CHANGES-

This is a conversion of StardewValley_Girl-byAdarin.  It's a slightly zoomed out view of Alex's portrait where you can now see her newly added ample breasts, It also comes with a new rockin' body for Alex's character!  I made this as an alternative for people who like big boobies but don't want all the female characters running around nude all the time.  I Also changed Alex's workout routine so no more lifting weights for her!  I wanted to keep things as lore friendly as possible so Alex now spends her free time in her room twerking to keep her body fit.  I do plan on making more mods similar to this for the other characters in the game.

-RECOMMENDED MODS-

I highly recommend using StardewValley_Girl-byAdarin along with this since the face model for female Alex was designed by them originally and there are multiple other characters that they have converted.  I would also recommend using Dialogue Changes Full for 1.1 by KeionDryke so that everyone in the game refers to Alex as a female and not a male.

-INSTALLATION-

Portrait-
Take the Alex.xnb file and put it in your (Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits) folder.  It will ask you to overwrite, click yes.  This will replace Alex's default portrait set with the new busty female Alex one.  Make sure to save a copy of your old Alex.xnb file somewhere to keep as a backup.

Character-
Take the Alex.xnb file and put it in your (Stardew Valley\Content\Characters) folder.  It will ask you to overwrite, click yes.  This will replace Alex's default character sprite with the new busty female Alex one.  Make sure to save a copy of your old Alex.xnb file somewhere to keep as a backup.
